bead.title: Add GitHub Actions deployment backend matrix
bead.description:
PROBLEM: GitHub Actions currently runs Helm static validation, but it does not run a deployment matrix that proves both supported Helm backend profiles through kind on capable runners.

ROOT CAUSE: `.github/workflows/ci.yml:56` defines a Helm job that only runs `bash scripts/ci/helm-gate.sh`, `.github/workflows/nightly.yml:40` only runs the existing nightly gate, and `.github/workflows/release.yml:55` only runs `bash scripts/ci/release-gate.sh` before packaging and publishing release artifacts.

PROPOSED FIX: Update `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/nightly.yml`, and/or `.github/workflows/release.yml` so GitHub Actions has an explicit deployment matrix for `postgres_native` and `object_log_sqlite_projection`. The matrix must run Helm static validation and `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend <profile>` on Ubuntu runners with Docker/kind/kubectl/helm available, and it must not rely on the local skip path to satisfy CI proof.

GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: Parent bead `pqueue-4d588c37`; epic `pqueue-3546063c`; `docs/helix/04-build/BUILD-001-implementation-plan.md`; `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md`; `docs/deployment/kind-helm-integration.md`.

DEPENDENCY IDS: `pqueue-728222f1`, `pqueue-0f1e8ba6`.

NON-SCOPE: Cutting the release tag.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestActionsDeploymentMatrixProfiles: GitHub Actions defines a deployment matrix containing exactly `postgres_native` and `object_log_sqlite_projection` for kind Helm integration proof.
2. TestActionsHelmStaticValidationIncluded: the workflow runs `bash scripts/ci/helm-gate.sh` as part of the deployment proof surface before or alongside the backend matrix.
3. TestActionsKindMatrixIsNotSkipped: the GitHub Actions matrix runs `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend postgres_native` and `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend object_log_sqlite_projection` on capable Ubuntu runners without accepting local Docker/kind skip output as success.
4. TestActionsReleaseGateComposition: release-oriented workflow coverage preserves `bash scripts/ci/release-gate.sh` behavior and either invokes `bash scripts/ci/deployment-release-gate.sh` or runs equivalent release gate, Helm, docs, and kind proof commands explicitly.
5. TestQualityGates: `go test ./...` and `lefthook run pre-commit` pass from the repository root after workflow changes.
